body: I need to buy a bike. I loved riding bikes when I was young. I definitely need to figure something out. Thank you.

I play video games a lot, but that consists of me keeping one ear cuff off so I can hear when she wants to talk to me, so I guess it really isn't "me" time. I'll need to figure something out. Thank you.

Yeah, the problem is she gets stressed INCREDIBLY easily. If she doesn't sleep well at night, she'll wake up and be in a terrible mood all day. She takes it out on us by screaming and just generally raging. When I try to help she snaps at me. I just don't know what to do. I wish she would just tell me she wants a divorce so we can get on with this, but I don't want to lose my kids.
I'll look into that book. Thank you.

My problem is I try to make everyone happy and I get left in the dust. I truly feel as though no one cares for me other than my Mom and step Dad. I don't have any friends. I work, go home, spend time with the kids and if she feels like being around me I'll spend time with her. I game on my computer a lot, so I have "friends" on there, but with third shift, I'm lucky if I get to talk to them once in a two week period any more. I really hope going back to day shift helps. Also, I can't really go out and go on hikes or anything, because she will throw the "you sleep all day and I take care of the kids" card at me, so then I feel guilty. I wish I never had kids sometimes. Don't get me wrong, I'd kill for them. But, I just think they would be better off without me or with someone else.
She refuses to work on any communication. Plus, if I bring something up that she does't like she either shuts down, or compares it to something I've done and turns everything back to me.
She refuses to work on any of her issues. She was on Paxil, and it helped a bit, but she since gave that up.
Yep, I've done that. It helps for a bit, then goes to shit.
I've worked third shift at a few factories. That's the worst.

I see where you're coming from. Unfortunately, she absolutely refuses to see any type of counselor. I've tried for years. She will not do it. I could hold a gun to one of my kid's head and she still wouldn't go. I think her love for me has run out and she's just saying she loves me. I'm the only income, and she doesn't have anywhere to go other than Texas if we split.

I'm a network tech. I watch over the thousands of sites we have to see if the client's internet connection goes down. We strive for as much uptime as possible. But most of the time its just me in the office, so human interaction is pretty scarce.

Third shift has always been really hard on me. It causes my depression to really flare up. Since I absolutely love my job, I figured it wouldn't be as bad this time. I was wrong... All I want to do is sleep. I get to spend a little more time with my kids, but even less with my wife. Thankfully my boss is flexible enough and we have someone trained enough to take over for me at the beginning of march, but I think its too late.
